native_capture: Full ordinary native Rerun window; no crop/edit/tooltip; software rasterizer disclosed. Final metadata wording recapture is byte-identical to the frame supplied to all three nonblank hosted calls.

producer.execution: This workflow uses Open3D's legacy geometry and registration API and ran entirely on CPU. That is a statement about what was executed here, not about Open3D as a whole: Open3D also ships a tensor API with CUDA-backed registration, which this workflow does not use.

source_relationship: The image was built at e62ab7073, not the later PR source. The later source includes a shipped descriptive docstring correction, test formatting and non-shipped documentation. Executable behavior was reviewed separately; source bytes are not identical.

recording_identity.derived_from: sha256 over the decoded geometry arrays

timelines.fragment_index: dataset fragment index, carried through from the run
timelines.log_time_and_log_tick: generated by this export. They are export metadata and are neither capture time nor a trajectory.

data_equality.export_recording_start_time_and_log_time: Generated by export, not physical capture times. These and SDK row/blueprint IDs change when metadata is regenerated.

camera_review.method: Read each actual serialized EyeControls3D entity with native Rerun rrd print -vvv; identify its parent view by decoded label; compare up/look-target/position as float32 against the original recorded cameras.

views.view: Scene: observed scan and supported surface

camera_review.default_layout: Scene pane plus tabs at 2:1; observed-only tab active; removed surface isolated; side panels collapsed as declared by the shipped default.

metadata_privacy_review.method: Positive literal provenance construction, closed data entity/component set, recursively decoded provenance, full data schema/store metadata, and all 25 blueprint entities decoded at maximum detail. Numerical arrays are separately exact-equal to actual output arrays.
metadata_privacy_review.scope: This specific public derivative and review pack. This is not a universal secret-detection guarantee. Raw operational recording/provider responses remain private.

limitations: no real-sensor accuracy: the dataset is synthetic
fitness and inlier RMSE are agreement measures between clouds, not absolute pose error; these scans carry no ground-truth pose
no physics-ready or simulation-ready geometry claim
no completeness claim: the capture is partial and the surface is open
support and crop measurements do not establish that removed surface was fabricated; sparse but correct surface reads the same way
